title: CERN 大型強子對撞機
subcategoryTitle: 大型加速器與光源設施
summary: 從磁剛度與亮度公式出發，理解為何 7 TeV 的質子需要 8.33 T 的 NbTi 偶極磁鐵與 1.9 K 超流氦，再把 362 MJ 的束流能量、準直與淬火保護、軌道與光學量測、注入與加速週期整合成一條可交接給操作團隊的對撞機工程鏈。
summaryEn: Start from magnetic rigidity and the luminosity formula to see why 7 TeV protons need 8.33 T NbTi dipoles and 1.9 K superfluid helium, then integrate the 362 MJ stored beam energy, collimation and quench protection, orbit and optics measurement, and the injection and ramp cycle into a collider engineering chain that can be handed to the operations team.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」與「亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius" and "Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “26.7 km ring and main dipoles” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 帶電粒子在磁場中的彎轉由磁剛度 Bρ = p/q 決定，對質子而言 Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]。LHC 沿用 LEP 的 26,659 m 隧道，彎轉只能由 1232 顆磁長 14.3 m 的主偶極磁鐵提供，因此彎轉半徑被固定在約 2804 m，要把質子推到 7 TeV 就必須有 8.33 T 的偶極場，這遠超過鐵磁飽和的 2 T，只能靠超導線圈。對撞機的優勢在質心能量：兩束 7 TeV 對撞得到 √s = 14 TeV，而 7 TeV 質子打固定靶只有 √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bending of a charged particle in a magnetic field is governed by the magnetic rigidity Bρ = p/q, which for protons reads Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]. The LHC reuses the 26,659 m LEP tunnel, and all bending comes from 1232 main dipoles of 14.3 m magnetic length, so the bending radius is fixed near 2804 m; reaching 7 TeV therefore demands a dipole field of 8.33 T, far beyond the 2 T saturation of iron and achievable only with superconducting coils. The collider's advantage is centre-of-mass energy: two 7 TeV beams give √s = 14 TeV, whereas a 7 TeV proton on a fixed target yields only √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “26.7 km ring and main dipoles”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “26.7 km ring and main dipoles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑
knowledge.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius
knowledge.text: 帶電粒子在磁場中的彎轉由磁剛度 Bρ = p/q 決定，對質子而言 Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]。LHC 沿用 LEP 的 26,659 m 隧道，彎轉只能由 1232 顆磁長 14.3 m 的主偶極磁鐵提供，因此彎轉半徑被固定在約 2804 m，要把質子推到 7 TeV 就必須有 8.33 T 的偶極場，這遠超過鐵磁飽和的 2 T，只能靠超導線圈。
knowledge.textEn: Bending of a charged particle in a magnetic field is governed by the magnetic rigidity Bρ = p/q, which for protons reads Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]. The LHC reuses the 26,659 m LEP tunnel, and all bending comes from 1232 main dipoles of 14.3 m magnetic length, so the bending radius is fixed near 2804 m; reaching 7 TeV therefore demands a dipole field of 8.33 T, far beyond the 2 T saturation of iron and achievable only with superconducting coils.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius" is correct?
options: 只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。
帶電粒子在磁場中的彎轉由磁剛度 Bρ = p/q 決定，對質子而言 Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]。
亮度只跟束流能量有關，能量越高亮度越高。
optionsEn: With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV.
Bending of a charged particle in a magnetic field is governed by the magnetic rigidity Bρ = p/q, which for protons reads Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c].
Luminosity depends only on beam energy, so higher energy means higher luminosity.
quiz.explanation: 帶電粒子在磁場中的彎轉由磁剛度 Bρ = p/q 決定，對質子而言 Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bending of a charged particle in a magnetic field is governed by the magnetic rigidity Bρ = p/q, which for protons reads Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “26.7 km ring and main dipoles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Bρ = 3.3356×7000 = 23,349 T·m；ρ = 1232×14.3 m/(2π) = 2804 m；B = 23,349/2804 = 8.33 T。Run 3 的 6.8 TeV 對應 8.09 T。固定靶的質心能量 √(2×7000 GeV×0.938 GeV) = 114.6 GeV，比對撞的 14,000 GeV 小 122 倍。這說明對撞機設計必須用超導磁鐵在固定隧道內提高彎轉磁場，而非只提高束流能量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bρ = 3.3356×7000 = 23,349 T·m; ρ = 1232×14.3 m/(2π) = 2804 m; B = 23,349/2804 = 8.33 T. The 6.8 TeV of Run 3 corresponds to 8.09 T. The fixed-target centre-of-mass energy √(2×7000 GeV×0.938 GeV) = 114.6 GeV is 122 times smaller than the 14,000 GeV of collisions. This is why a collider in a fixed tunnel must raise the bending field with superconducting magnets rather than raise beam energy alone. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π；再由束流的迴旋頻率 11,245 Hz 與 RF 頻率反推軌道長度，與 26,659 m 比較，差異應在毫米等級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Multiply each dipole's rotating-coil transfer function at 1.9 K (in T/kA) by the operating current and check that the 1232 bending angles sum to exactly 2π; then infer the orbit length from the 11,245 Hz revolution frequency and the RF frequency and compare with 26,659 m, where the difference should be at the millimetre level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Bρ = 3.3356×7000 = 23,349 T·m；ρ = 1232×14.3 m/(2π) = 2804 m；B = 23,349/2804 = 8.33 T。Run 3 的 6.8 TeV 對應 8.09 T。固定靶的質心能量 √(2×7000 GeV×0.938 GeV) = 114.6 GeV，比對撞的 14,000 GeV 小 122 倍。這說明對撞機設計必須用超導磁鐵在固定隧道內提高彎轉磁場，而非只提高束流能量。
knowledge.textEn: Bρ = 3.3356×7000 = 23,349 T·m; ρ = 1232×14.3 m/(2π) = 2804 m; B = 23,349/2804 = 8.33 T. The 6.8 TeV of Run 3 corresponds to 8.09 T. The fixed-target centre-of-mass energy √(2×7000 GeV×0.938 GeV) = 114.6 GeV is 122 times smaller than the 14,000 GeV of collisions. This is why a collider in a fixed tunnel must raise the bending field with superconducting magnets rather than raise beam energy alone.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius", which statement holds?
options: 冷到 4.2 K 已經是超導，再冷到 1.9 K 只是浪費電。
束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。
optionsEn: Superconducting at 4.2 K already, going to 1.9 K merely wastes electricity.
The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm.

steps.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “26.7 km ring and main dipoles” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π；再由束流的迴旋頻率 11,245 Hz 與 RF 頻率反推軌道長度，與 26,659 m 比較，差異應在毫米等級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Multiply each dipole's rotating-coil transfer function at 1.9 K (in T/kA) by the operating current and check that the 1232 bending angles sum to exactly 2π; then infer the orbit length from the 11,245 Hz revolution frequency and the RF frequency and compare with 26,659 m, where the difference should be at the millimetre level. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若磁鐵傳遞函數的校正偏差 10⁻³，所有偶極同向多彎，束流中心能量與 RF 鎖定的軌道長度不再一致，束流被迫沿徑向偏移以補償，最終撞上孔徑或在加速中失去。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 10⁻³ calibration error in the dipole transfer function makes every dipole over-bend in the same direction; the beam's central energy no longer matches the RF-locked orbit length, the beam shifts radially to compensate and is eventually lost on the aperture or during the ramp.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π；再由束流的迴旋頻率 11,245 Hz 與 RF 頻率反推軌道長度，與 26,659 m 比較，差異應在毫米等級。
knowledge.textEn: Multiply each dipole's rotating-coil transfer function at 1.9 K (in T/kA) by the operating current and check that the 1232 bending angles sum to exactly 2π; then infer the orbit length from the 11,245 Hz revolution frequency and the RF frequency and compare with 26,659 m, where the difference should be at the millimetre level.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius"?
options: 用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
16 MV 的 RF 電壓是用來把質子從 450 GeV 加速到 7 TeV 的主要動力。
optionsEn: Multiply each dipole's rotating-coil transfer function at 1.9 K (in T/kA) by the operating current and check that the 1232 bending angles sum to exactly 2π.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV.
quiz.explanation: 用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π；再由束流的迴旋頻率 11,245 Hz 與 RF 頻率反推軌道長度，與 26,659 m 比較，差異應在毫米等級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiply each dipole's rotating-coil transfer function at 1.9 K (in T/kA) by the operating current and check that the 1232 bending angles sum to exactly 2π; then infer the orbit length from the 11,245 Hz revolution frequency and the RF frequency and compare with 26,659 m, where the difference should be at the millimetre level. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “26.7 km ring and main dipoles” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若磁鐵傳遞函數的校正偏差 10⁻³，所有偶極同向多彎，束流中心能量與 RF 鎖定的軌道長度不再一致，束流被迫沿徑向偏移以補償，最終撞上孔徑或在加速中失去。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 10⁻³ calibration error in the dipole transfer function makes every dipole over-bend in the same direction; the beam's central energy no longer matches the RF-locked orbit length, the beam shifts radially to compensate and is eventually lost on the aperture or during the ramp. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對撞機的優勢在質心能量：兩束 7 TeV 對撞得到 √s = 14 TeV，而 7 TeV 質子打固定靶只有 √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The collider's advantage is centre-of-mass energy: two 7 TeV beams give √s = 14 TeV, whereas a 7 TeV proton on a fixed target yields only √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若磁鐵傳遞函數的校正偏差 10⁻³，所有偶極同向多彎，束流中心能量與 RF 鎖定的軌道長度不再一致，束流被迫沿徑向偏移以補償，最終撞上孔徑或在加速中失去。
knowledge.textEn: A 10⁻³ calibration error in the dipole transfer function makes every dipole over-bend in the same direction; the beam's central energy no longer matches the RF-locked orbit length, the beam shifts radially to compensate and is eventually lost on the aperture or during the ramp.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若磁鐵傳遞函數的校正偏差 10⁻³，所有偶極同向多彎，束流中心能量與 RF 鎖定的軌道長度不再一致，束流被迫沿徑向偏移以補償，最終撞上孔徑或在加速中失去。
亮度只跟束流能量有關，能量越高亮度越高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A 10⁻³ calibration error in the dipole transfer function makes every dipole over-bend in the same direction.
Luminosity depends only on beam energy, so higher energy means higher luminosity.
quiz.explanation: 若磁鐵傳遞函數的校正偏差 10⁻³，所有偶極同向多彎，束流中心能量與 RF 鎖定的軌道長度不再一致，束流被迫沿徑向偏移以補償，最終撞上孔徑或在加速中失去。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A 10⁻³ calibration error in the dipole transfer function makes every dipole over-bend in the same direction; the beam's central energy no longer matches the RF-locked orbit length, the beam shifts radially to compensate and is eventually lost on the aperture or during the ramp. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「亮度公式與對撞點 β*」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Luminosity formula and β* at the interaction point” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 對撞機的產率由亮度決定：事件率 = L×σ。對於 n_b 個團、每團 N 個質子、迴旋頻率 f_rev、正規化發射度 ε_n、對撞點 β 函數 β* 的高斯束，L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F，F 是交叉角造成的幾何損失因子。亮度隨每團粒子數平方上升，所以注入鏈必須提供高亮度的團，同時 β* 要由最後一組三合一超導四極磁鐵壓到次公尺等級。對撞點束流尺寸 σ* = √(ε_n·β*/γ) 只有十幾微米，兩束必須以微米精度對準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「亮度公式與對撞點 β*」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A collider's output is set by luminosity: event rate = L×σ. For Gaussian beams with n_b bunches of N protons each, revolution frequency f_rev, normalized emittance ε_n and interaction-point beta function β*, L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F, where F is the geometric loss from the crossing angle. Luminosity grows with the square of the bunch population, so the injector chain must deliver bright bunches, while β* is squeezed to sub-metre values by the final triplet of superconducting quadrupoles. The beam size at the interaction point, σ* = √(ε_n·β*/γ), is only some tens of micrometres, so the two beams must be aligned to micrometre precision. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Luminosity formula and β* at the interaction point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「亮度只跟束流能量有關，能量越高亮度越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Luminosity depends only on beam energy, so higher energy means higher luminosity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「亮度公式與對撞點 β*」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Luminosity formula and β* at the interaction point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*
knowledge.text: 對撞機的產率由亮度決定：事件率 = L×σ。對於 n_b 個團、每團 N 個質子、迴旋頻率 f_rev、正規化發射度 ε_n、對撞點 β 函數 β* 的高斯束，L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F，F 是交叉角造成的幾何損失因子。
knowledge.textEn: A collider's output is set by luminosity: event rate = L×σ. For Gaussian beams with n_b bunches of N protons each, revolution frequency f_rev, normalized emittance ε_n and interaction-point beta function β*, L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F, where F is the geometric loss from the crossing angle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：亮度只跟束流能量有關，能量越高亮度越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Luminosity depends only on beam energy, so higher energy means higher luminosity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*" is correct?
options: 亮度只跟束流能量有關，能量越高亮度越高。
超導磁鐵一旦冷卻到工作溫度就不會再淬火。
對撞機的產率由亮度決定：事件率 = L×σ。
optionsEn: Luminosity depends only on beam energy, so higher energy means higher luminosity.
Once cooled to operating temperature a superconducting magnet can no longer quench.
A collider's output is set by luminosity: event rate = L×σ.

steps.title: 亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「亮度公式與對撞點 β*」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Luminosity formula and β* at the interaction point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 N = 1.15×10¹¹、n_b = 2808、f_rev = 11,245 Hz、γ = 7461、ε_n = 3.75 µm、β* = 0.55 m、F = 0.84：L = (1.15×10¹¹)²×2808×11245×7461/(4π×3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹；σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 16.6 µm。代入時各項需使用一致單位，並記得交叉角幾何因子 F 會降低亮度，β* 越小此損失越明顯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With N = 1.15×10¹¹, n_b = 2808, f_rev = 11,245 Hz, γ = 7461, ε_n = 3.75 µm, β* = 0.55 m and F = 0.84: L = (1.15×10¹¹)²×2808×11245×7461/(4π×3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹, and σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 16.6 µm. Insert every term in consistent units and remember that the crossing-angle geometric factor F reduces luminosity, a loss that grows as β* shrinks. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：做 van der Meer 掃描：讓兩束在對撞點沿水平與垂直方向互相掃過，記錄事件率對位移的曲線，由曲線寬度得到有效束流重疊尺寸 Σ_x、Σ_y，再以 L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y) 計算絕對亮度，與用發射度和 β* 算出的值比較，差異應在幾個百分點內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Perform a van der Meer scan: sweep the two beams across each other horizontally and vertically at the interaction point, record event rate against displacement, obtain the effective overlap sizes Σ_x and Σ_y from the curve widths, compute the absolute luminosity as L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y), and compare with the value predicted from emittance and β*, which should agree to within a few percent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With N = 1.15×10¹¹, n_b = 2808, f_rev = 11,245 Hz, γ = 7461, ε_n = 3.75 µm, β* = 0.55 m and F = 0.84: L = (1.15×10¹¹)²×2808×11245×7461/(4π×3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹, and σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 16.6 µm. Insert every term in consistent units and remember that the crossing-angle geometric factor F reduces luminosity, a loss that grows as β* shrinks.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*", which statement holds?
options: 超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。
16 MV 的 RF 電壓是用來把質子從 450 GeV 加速到 7 TeV 的主要動力。
optionsEn: A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history.
The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV.

steps.title: 亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「亮度公式與對撞點 β*」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Luminosity formula and β* at the interaction point” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 做 van der Meer 掃描：讓兩束在對撞點沿水平與垂直方向互相掃過，記錄事件率對位移的曲線，由曲線寬度得到有效束流重疊尺寸 Σ_x、Σ_y，再以 L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y) 計算絕對亮度，與用發射度和 β* 算出的值比較，差異應在幾個百分點內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Perform a van der Meer scan: sweep the two beams across each other horizontally and vertically at the interaction point, record event rate against displacement, obtain the effective overlap sizes Σ_x and Σ_y from the curve widths, compute the absolute luminosity as L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y), and compare with the value predicted from emittance and β*, which should agree to within a few percent. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：發射度在注入鏈或注入過程中膨脹一倍，亮度直接減半；若誤以為加大每團粒子數可以補回，束流與束流的交互作用會讓調諧值偏移、損失上升，最終反而縮短填充壽命。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the emittance doubles in the injector chain or at injection, luminosity halves outright; trying to compensate with larger bunch populations drives beam-beam tune shifts and losses up and ultimately shortens the fill lifetime.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 做 van der Meer 掃描：讓兩束在對撞點沿水平與垂直方向互相掃過，記錄事件率對位移的曲線，由曲線寬度得到有效束流重疊尺寸 Σ_x、Σ_y，再以 L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y) 計算絕對亮度，與用發射度和 β* 算出的值比較，差異應在幾個百分點內。
knowledge.textEn: Perform a van der Meer scan: sweep the two beams across each other horizontally and vertically at the interaction point, record event rate against displacement, obtain the effective overlap sizes Σ_x and Σ_y from the curve widths, compute the absolute luminosity as L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y), and compare with the value predicted from emittance and β*, which should agree to within a few percent.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
做 van der Meer 掃描：讓兩束在對撞點沿水平與垂直方向互相掃過，記錄事件率對位移的曲線，由曲線寬度得到有效束流重疊尺寸 Σ_x、Σ_y，再以 L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y) 計算絕對亮度，與用發射度和 β* 算出的值比較，差異應在幾個百分點內。
每顆磁鐵都在測試站通過驗收，整個電路就不需要再量接頭。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Perform a van der Meer scan: sweep the two beams across each other horizontally and vertically at the interaction point, record event rate against displacement, obtain the effective overlap sizes Σ_x and Σ_y from the curve widths, compute the absolute luminosity as L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y), and compare with the value predicted from emittance and β*, which should agree to within a few percent.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「亮度公式與對撞點 β*」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Luminosity formula and β* at the interaction point” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 發射度在注入鏈或注入過程中膨脹一倍，亮度直接減半；若誤以為加大每團粒子數可以補回，束流與束流的交互作用會讓調諧值偏移、損失上升，最終反而縮短填充壽命。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the emittance doubles in the injector chain or at injection, luminosity halves outright; trying to compensate with larger bunch populations drives beam-beam tune shifts and losses up and ultimately shortens the fill lifetime. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對撞點束流尺寸 σ* = √(ε_n·β*/γ) 只有十幾微米，兩束必須以微米精度對準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The beam size at the interaction point, σ* = √(ε_n·β*/γ), is only some tens of micrometres, so the two beams must be aligned to micrometre precision.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「亮度只跟束流能量有關，能量越高亮度越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Luminosity depends only on beam energy, so higher energy means higher luminosity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Once cooled to operating temperature a superconducting magnet can no longer quench.
